questions.question:
HAI already supports per-agent workspace settings, so the additional outcome is unclear.
What should BL-0009 accomplish beyond the current mechanism?
questions.impact: Determines whether the deliverable is confirmation of existing coverage, a new setup workflow, or broader configuration support.

options.label: A
options.text: Confirm that the existing mechanism satisfies this story, with evidence and any remaining gaps documented.

options.label: B
options.text: Add a guided setup flow for configuring an agent in a workspace.

options.label: C
options.text: Expand the settings agents can declare beyond booleans and workspace-relative directories.

questions.question:
The draft gives no motivating problem or example, so we cannot define meaningful acceptance criteria.
What concrete setup scenario should define success: which agent, which parameter, which workspace-specific value or behavior, and what difficulty should this resolve? If the existing mechanism is sufficient, say so.
questions.impact: Establishes the user need and an observable acceptance scenario without inventing requirements.
